title: The Torn Scripture
text: The apostates have torn a holy book into pages and nailed them to every door in the street. Each page has been rewritten in a careful hand, the old words crossed out, new ones written over them. The new words are worse.

options.label: The wisest reads the rewritten pages, to learn what the Court truly believes.

outcomes.text: The Court's real creed, in their own hand.
It makes too much sense, and they cannot unread it.

options.label: Gather the pages to restore the book, door by door, whatever the Court thinks.

outcomes.text: Slow, careful work, door by door, and the Court notices.

options.label: Burn every page, so the new words spread no further.

outcomes.text: The Court comes running before the smoke clears.
